rationale: Same-field retrieval is needed to remain grounded in electrochemical storage feasibility, including batteries, flow systems, solid electrolytes, and recycling. Cross-domain retrieval is justified because the core bottlenecks involve interfacial stability, chemomechanical failure, direct material restoration, and lifecycle-aware optimization, where mechanisms from corrosion passivation, membrane-electrode systems, mineral processing, fracture mechanics, or digital twins may transfer.
